title: Unfit Properties
description: A list of the houses in Syracuse that have been declared as unfit by Code Enforcement. The process begins when a member of the community makes a call or complaint to Code Enforcement. A Code Enforcement Investigator is then assigned and goes to the home to do an inspection. The investigator then makes a determination if the complaints rise to the level of a violation against local or state housing laws. The Code Enforcement Department sends a letter to the landlord informing them of a comply by date, that the landlord is ordered to remedy the concerns by. Possible reasons an unfit violation may not be resolved by comply-by date include: The property is vacant / owned by the Greater Syracuse Land Bank The property is in the pipeline to be demolished The owner is non-compliant and the complaint has been referred to the Law Department to pursue in court The owner is non-compliant and the complaint has been referred to the Bureau of Administrative Adjudication (BAA) for further ticketing and fines Data Dictionary: Label Definition Definition Source violation_date Date violation was cited Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) status_date Date the violation status was created or changed Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) comply_by_date The violation compliance date per inspector Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) corrective_action The corrective action required for compliance per inspector Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) area_involved The physical area that the violation applies to per inspector Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) complaint_number Case number of violation’s parent complaint record Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) SBL Stands for Section, Block, Lot. This is a property tax number unique to this property. Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) comp_open_date The date that the violation’s parent complaint record was opened Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) comp_close_date The date that the violation’s parent complaint record was closed. Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) Violation The violation type, this references the name of the specific code in violation, including the name and section of the codebook it comes from Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) article The article of the specific code in violation Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) comp_status Status of violation’s parent complaint Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) parcel_id The number of this property parcel in the NYS Property database. Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) owner_middle_name Middle name/initial of the registered owner of the property Divison of Code Enforcment (DOCE) owner_last_name Last name of the registered owner of the property.
